name: Tangrowth
description: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.description: The user attacks by draining the target’s nutrients. Some of the damage dealt to the target is absorbed by the user to restore their own HP.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of toxic powder that poisons the target.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.description: The user adapts a hard-hitting stance to increase the damage dealt by its moves by 50 percent.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a primeval power. This may also raise the user's offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of sleep-inducing powder that makes the target drowsy.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target to deal damage. This may also poison the target.
